# Ashford Digital

> Ashford Digital builds monthly-subscription websites for UK small businesses and helps them get customers. It is a sole trader based in Gainsborough, Lincolnshire, run by Robbie. Every site starts as a free private demo built from the business's Google listing, before the owner pays anything.

## Key facts
- Plans: Starter £29/month, Standard £49/month, Pro £89/month (£59/month founding price for the first 5 Pro clients). No setup fee. No free trial month.
- Minimum term: 2 monthly payments, then cancel with 30 days' notice.
- Pro includes the Customer Engine (local demand-timed Google ads with a spend cap paid directly to Google, past-customer reminders, tracked referral codes, introductions to letting agents and builders) and a 60-day results guarantee: first tracked enquiry within 60 days of going live, or 3 months free (conditions apply).
- No client case studies or reviews yet; the business is taking on its first clients.
